skill.summary: Theme speed and UX optimization — Core Web Vitals, Liquid code, image loading, mobile responsiveness

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Shopify Theme Optimization skill.

- Provides expert guidance on Core Web Vitals, Liquid code, image loading, and mobile responsiveness for Shopify themes.
- Analyzes your store and offers data-driven, prioritized recommendations.
- Generates step-by-step implementation plans and compares optimization tools and strategies.
- Output includes assessments, action items, tool/app suggestions, timelines, and KPIs to track.
- Strategic guidance only—no direct Shopify API integration.
